headline: Public hearings on Wendy's 4:00 AM hours at 23 Mason Street, a liquor license renewal, and a new café on Columbus Avenue.
summary: The agenda also lists a liquor license renewal for Stateline Wine & Spirits and a December 26 party permit at 120 High Street. Most items are 26 renewals on the consent agenda.
